Verified on `go1.26.0 linux/amd64` in `/home/kara/lru` (`go mod init lru`):

```bash
$ go vet .                          # clean
$ go run -race .                    # run 1-4, all identical results
```

Output (representative run):

```
=== go-sharded-lru-eviction-race: concurrency-safe LRU cache ===
deterministic recency/eviction tests:        ok (T1-T9)
concurrent stress (64 x 10k):                 ok (448572 puts, 75639 hits, 115789 misses; 640000 ops replayed; final len=64)
capacity-0 concurrent reject-all-puts:       ok
perf smoke (1M ops, cap 1000):                1.258s (0.8 M ops/s) -> O(1) amortized   # under -race
ALL TESTS PASSED
```

- **Race detector**: `go run -race .` passed 4/4 runs (each run uses fresh `time.Now()`-derived seeds, so schedules and op interleavings differ; zero race reports from the 640k-op concurrent phase, the hot-key contention, or the 16-goroutine capacity-0 hammer).
- **Deterministic recency-order assertions (T1–T9)**: exact list order checked after every mutation — eviction always removes the true LRU key (`Put d` after `Get b` evicts `a`, not `c`); `Get` refreshes recency; `Put` of an existing key updates the value with size unchanged; capacity 1, capacity 0 and negative capacity behave correctly; `nil` values and miss results `(nil, false)` handled.
- **Linearizability replay**: all 640,000 recorded ops replayed on an independently coded O(n) reference LRU; every per-op Get result and Put "existed" flag matched, and the final state (values **and exact recency order**) matched — the concurrent cache is equivalent to a valid serial execution.
- **Structural invariants**: after every test, map size == list size, no duplicate keys, every list key in map and vice versa.
- **Complexity**: non-instrumented run does 1M ops (cap 1000, keys 0–4999 so evictions occur) in 187 ms ≈ 5.3 M ops/s — linear/O(1)-amortized behavior, no per-op scans in the hot path.
- **Edge cases covered**: empty cache Get; Get on evicted key; repeated Gets (size unchanged); single-capacity cache; capacity 0 / negative capacity (reject all puts, also under 16 concurrent goroutines); `Put(k, nil)` returning `(nil, true)`; 20% hot-key contention on one key from all 64 goroutines; op counters sum exactly to 640,000.
